Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.

Earlier update log: Fashionably Late Update. This update includes tons of new major content and reworks. Nearly everything in the game has been changed up to some extent, check it out!
UPDATE LOG: A small bit of content and a TON of bug fixes and rebalancings. This is the most bug fixes Die of Death has gotten in any update ever! Intention behind this patch is to fix up the game back to its glory again.

🏍️ Ride — Experience realistic bike physics and take on the streets.

🔧 Customize — Upgrade your performance, change your setup, and make your bike truly yours.

💰 Make Money — Work, complete deliveries, trade memecoins, and find new ways to build your wealth.

🌆 Explore — Discover a dynamic city with ambient sounds, working traffic, and an immersive urban atmosphere.

🤝 Live the Lifestyle — Ride with friends, build your reputation, and create your own story.

Your bike. Your hustle. Your city.

Welcome to NEXRIDE.

10770251720.name: Get A Grip [BETA]
10770251720.description:
Explore the vibrant streets of Redcliff City using our unique climbing mechanics! Scale buildings, discover hidden spots, use the public transport system to travel across town, visit surrounding villages, and explore iconic landmarks.

Whether you're looking for an interactive climbing sandbox, dynamic ragdoll physics, or a realistic roleplay experience, our expansive open-world offers endless possibilities!

Game Features:

Dynamic Climbing System: Traverse urban environments and obstacles with complete freedom.

Public Transit Network: Ride trams and trains to travel between cities and landmarks.

Vast Open World: Explore diverse towns, countryside locations, and secret areas.

Flexible Gameplay: Perfect for casual physics fun, exploration, or immersive roleplay.

Credits: @prOFFix51 (scripting help), @ostra_sklzavka (artwork for the game), @Lordof_Smiler (helping with building assets)
